wikitext: {{EpicodePrevNext| prevcode=PG08 | prevtitle=The Cavern | nextcode=PG10 | nexttitle=The Old Chateau | series=Pokémon Generations | colorscheme=Hoso}} {{EpisodeInfobox| epcode=PG09 | colorscheme=Hoso| title_en=The Scoop | title_ja=スクープ | title_ja_trans=The Scoop | release_method=Web release | screen=hd | broadcast_jp=December 16, 2016 | broadcast_us=October 28, 2016 | en_op=N/A | ja_op=N/A | ja_ed=N/A | olmteam=Team Kato | scenario=冨岡淳広 | storyboard=若野哲也 | directorn=2 | director1=若野哲也 | director2=山井紗也香 | artn=2 | art1=吉岡毅 | art2=イム　ドヨン | morecredits=no | epstaffpage=PG01-PG10 | footnotes=* ''[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S5SpyXCTyz4 The Scoop]'' on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel. * {{BMGf|219476|Review thread on BMGf}} }} '''The Scoop''' (Japanese: '''スクープ''' ''The Scoop'') is the ninth episode of [[Pokémon Generations]]. It was first released on the official English Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on October 28, 2016. It was uploaded to the official Japanese Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on December 16, 2016. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== While the Hoenn region rejoices after avoiding meteoric destruction, reporter Gabby and her cameraman Ty uncover the story of a lifetime. ==Plot== As a [[Grand Meteor Delta|meteor]] heads towards a {{pkmn|world|planet}}, a powerful blast of energy surges upwards and destroys it, also temporarily disabling a satellite recording footage of the incident. In the [[Mossdeep Space Center]], [[Gabby and Ty]] have secretly infiltrated the building. While Ty keeps a lookout at the door, Gabby attempts to locate and download some secret footage that the space center recorded, which allegedly shows more of the meteor incident. She manages to locate the file and starts downloading it onto her thumb drive, but her actions are detected by [[Professor Cozmo]] in the main control room. Unable to wait any longer, Gabby plays the footage while it downloads, and Ty leaves his post to watch as well. They see that the blast of energy that destroyed the meteor was {{me|Rayquaza}}, and are shocked to notice that {{player|a young Trainer}} in [[Magma Suit|a red spacesuit]] is riding the {{pkmn2|Legendary}} {{t|Dragon}}. Out of the destroyed meteor, a black triangle emerges and transforms into {{p|Deoxys}}. Deoxys and Mega Rayquaza begin exchanging attacks, but despite its ability to change {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Deoxys|its Forme}} and regenerate the lost parts of its body, Deoxys is eventually defeated by Mega Rayquaza's {{m|Dragon Ascent}} and {{pkmn2|caught}} by the {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s [[Ultra Ball]]. As Gabby is amazed by what she just saw, Ty points out that she was so focused on watching the footage that she had failed to notice that the download had finished quite a while ago. She picks up her thumb drive and declares that they should search for the Trainer who caught Deoxys, shocking Ty. When they try to leave the room, Professor Cozmo confronts them with a group of security guards and demands Gabby to surrender her findings. Gabby pretends to give him her thumb drive, but instead flings it away and picks it back up as she runs away, followed by Ty and the guards. Cozmo thinks to himself that the world is not ready yet to learn of the existence of [[Extraterrestrial Pokémon|Pokémon from outer space]]. ==Major events== * [[Gabby and Ty]] infiltrate the [[Mossdeep Space Center]] in order to find out the truth behind the [[Grand Meteor Delta|giant meteor]]'s destruction. * Gabby and Ty learn that the meteor was destroyed by {{me|Rayquaza}} ridden by {{player|a Trainer}}, and that it contained {{p|Deoxys|a Pokémon from outer space}}, which was {{pkmn2|caught|captured}} by the Trainer. ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{player|Trainer}} * [[Gabby and Ty]] * [[Professor Cozmo]] * [[Mossdeep Space Center]] {{tc|Scientist}}s * Guards * [[TV Mauville]] crew (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Rayquaza}} ({{player|Trainer}}'s;
